battle_traits.name: Immortal Elite
battle_traits.declare: You must use this ability if there are any OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HEROES on the battlefield. Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: You gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number after the target's RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent relentless discipline points are lost.

battle_traits.name: Remorseless March
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of that unit for the rest of the phase. That unit cannot use RUN abilities for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: Impassive Retreat
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: Ruthless Extermination
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for a unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that SHOOT ability.

battle_traits.name: Pitiless Assault
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase.
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made as part of that FIGHT ability.

battle_traits.name: Inviolate Legions
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability.
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. That unit has WARD (5+) against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability.

abilities.name: Grim Sentinels
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.

abilities.name: Nadirite Wedge
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Silent Empire
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.

abilities.name: Unfaltering Pace
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability for a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit.
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Plentiful Bone
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to use this ability, then pick up to 3 visible friendly non-FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units wholly within 12" of that WIZARD to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is damaged, Heal (X) the target where X is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic equal to or less than the roll.

abilities.name: Disciplined Hekatoi
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO non-FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.
• The target has WARD (5+).
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks.
• The target's melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).

entries.name: Manufactured Mind
entries.effect: When picking a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO to be the target of the 'Immortal Elite' ability this battle round, you can pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO that has been destroyed.

entries.name: Immaculate Defender
entries.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY unit in the combat phase while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Imperious Will
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
entries.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that non-HERO unit and that did not charge this turn to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per FIGHT ability.

entries.name: Shard of the Necris
entries.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4 and this unit did not charge in the same turn, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

entries.name: Blade of the Nadir
entries.effect: Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons. For the rest of the battle, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made with that weapon, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Amulet of Gnosis
entries.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units by RETREAT abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Banner of Old Ossia
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Rally' command for a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit
entries.effect:
When resolving that command, you can spend rally points in the following additional ways:
• For each rally point spent, Heal (1) another visible friendly non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
• You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Scarabaean Cloak
entries.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Soulweb Gem
entries.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it was destroyed this turn.
entries.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to this unit on the battlefield wholly within friendly territory and not in combat. Then, allocate a number of damage points to the replacement unit equal to its Health characteristic minus 1 (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

entries.name: Perpetually Empowered Weapons
entries.effect: This unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits).

entries.name: Elongated Tibias
entries.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

entries.name: Utterly Unquestioning
entries.effect: Each time this unit uses a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 5+, subtract 1 from the number of relentless discipline points that must be spent to use that ability.

entries.name: Empower Nadirite Weapons
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
The target's melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) until the start of your next turn. If all of the target's non-Companion melee weapons had Crit (2 Hits) when they were picked to be the target of this ability, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.


Friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units can be affected by this ability multiple times.

entries.name: Immolating Flames
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Drain Vitality
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks and subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

entries.name: Bolster Creation
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase.

entries.name: Invigorate the Ranks
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Soul-Claim
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of that WIZARD to be a friendly target. Then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. If any models are slain by this ability, pick 1 of the following:
• Heal (3) the friendly target.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

entries.name: Summon Nightmare Predator
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Nightmare Predator on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Nightmare Predator wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Bone-tithe Shrieker
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Bone‑tithe Shrieker on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Bone-tithe Shrieker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Soulstealer Carrion
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulstealer Carrion on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Soulstealer Carrion wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
